description: The capabilities the main window is granted. Every entry is here because a feature needs it. The dialog plugin may only open and save — it returns a path a person chose, and only the host's own commands read or write there. Saving hands over one file, written after the code in it has been rendered, decoded and matched byte for byte. Opening hands over a logo, a CSV, or (for a batch) a folder: the interface never reads a file itself; the host reads the logo or the CSV once, under its caps, and never returns the path, and a batch writes only inside the folder chosen, one verified file per row, never over a file that is already there. There is no filesystem plugin, so nothing can walk a directory, and no shell plugin, so nothing can run a program.
